name: KSP App
postStartCommand: bash -c 'npm install --prefix /workspaces/ksp-app 2>/dev/null; if [ -n "$AUTH_SECRET" ]; then nohup node /workspaces/ksp-app/scripts/browser-runner-node.mjs > /tmp/runner.log 2>&1 & echo "[devcontainer] Browser runner started (PID $!)"; else echo "[devcontainer] AUTH_SECRET not set — runner not started. Run manually:"; echo "  AUTH_SECRET=<secret> node scripts/browser-runner-node.mjs"; fi'
